pr_body:
Fixes #103208.

I didn't find any unit test for this class, I tested the fix manually.
pr_comments: Why `logger.Value.MinLevel` is null? Maybe there's some deeper problem.

> The log level in MessageLogger is nullable and when the filters are applied, the result may be a null level

 I'm curious if a null level means None, All, or Undefined. Why it was returning `Trace`.
/ba-g the failure is already tracked with the issue https://github.com/dotnet/dnceng/issues/3007.

issue_context.title: `LoggerProviderDebugView` doesn't seem to report the correct log level
